en.title: Alaska Senate race under investigation for alleged voter confusion scheme
en.dek: The U.S. Department of Justice has opened a probe into a fake candidate in Alaska's Senate race, while Democratic lawmakers who backed Mary Peltola have not spoken out.
facts: DOJ alleges voter fraud by a fake candidate in Alaska Senate race
DOJ is isolating some Alaska ballots over same-name candidate issue
Democratic lawmakers who endorsed Mary Peltola have not condemned the alleged scheme
The DOJ approved a $3 billion sale of Patriot missiles to Ukraine
A federal judge blocked DOJ threats against election workers over ballots tied to suspected noncitizens
body: The Department of Justice has requested isolation of some Alaska ballots as part of a probe into whether the presence of two candidates with the same name could confuse voters, according to The Hill. The request was made on 31 October 2026. The request follows the DOJ's earlier allegation of voter fraud by a fake candidate, reported by Die Zeit. The same‑name issue was highlighted by Al Jazeera.

According to Die Zeit, the DOJ alleges voter fraud by a fake candidate in Alaska's Senate race. The allegation centers on a candidate who is not a registered voter. The DOJ claims the fake candidate could mislead voters. The investigation is part of a broader scrutiny of election integrity.

Al Jazeera reported that Alaska has two candidates named Dan Sullivan. The presence of identical names could lead to ballot stacking. The DOJ is examining whether this could confuse voters. The issue was cited in the isolation request.

Fox News reported that Democratic lawmakers who endorsed Mary Peltola stayed silent when asked to denounce the alleged scheme. The lawmakers have not issued a statement regarding the investigation. The silence was noted by political commentators. No official condemnation has been issued.

A federal judge blocked the Trump administration from threatening election workers with prosecution over ballots tied to suspected noncitizens, according to Fox News. The judge ordered the administration to cease the threats, as reported by The Hill. The order was issued ahead of the 2026 midterm elections. The judge's decision aimed to prevent intimidation of election officials.

The Trump administration approved a $3 billion sale of Patriot missiles to Ukraine, according to Dawn. The sale was confirmed by Congress, as reported by ABC Australia. The approval was reported by Dawn and ABC Australia. The sale is part of a broader effort to support Ukraine's defense capabilities.
en.context: The U.S. Department of Justice has investigated alleged voter fraud in multiple states during the 2026 election cycle, according to Die Zeit. A federal judge recently blocked the Trump administration from threatening election workers, as reported by Fox News and The Hill. The U.S. approved a $3 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine, reported by Dawn and ABC Australia.

en.headline: DOJ pushes to isolate Alaska ballots amid same-name candidate issue
en.body: The Department of Justice pushed to isolate some Alaska ballots as part of a probe into whether the presence of two candidates with the same name could confuse voters, according to The Hill. Al Jazeera reported that the same-name issue on the Alaska ballot triggered a Justice Department investigation.

es.headline: El DOJ impulsa la separación de boletas de Alaska por el problema de candidatos con el mismo nombre
es.body: El Departamento de Justicia impulsó la separación de algunas boletas de Alaska como parte de una investigación sobre si la presencia de dos candidatos con el mismo nombre podría confundir a los votantes, según The Hill. Al Jazeera informó que el problema de candidatos con el mismo nombre en la boleta de Alaska desencadenó una investigación del Departamento de Justicia.

fr.headline: Le DOJ pousse à isoler les bulletins de l'Alaska face à un problème de candidats portant le même nom
fr.body: Le Département de la Justice a demandé l'isolation de certains bulletins de l'Alaska dans le cadre d'une enquête visant à déterminer si la présence de deux candidats portant le même nom pouvait prêter à confusion aux électeurs, selon The Hill. Al Jazeera a rapporté que le problème de candidats portant le même nom sur le bulletin de l'Alaska a déclenché une enquête du Département de la Justice.

it.headline: Il Dipartimento di Giustizia spinge a isolare le schede di voto dell'Alaska a causa del problema di candidati con lo stesso nome
it.body: Il Dipartimento di Giustizia ha spinto a isolare alcune schede di voto dell'Alaska come parte di un'indagine sul fatto che la presenza di due candidati con lo stesso nome potesse confondere gli elettori, secondo The Hill. Al Jazeera ha riferito che il problema di candidati con lo stesso nome sull'elenco di voto dell'Alaska ha innescato un'indagine del Dipartimento di Giustizia.

pt.headline: DOJ tenta isolar votos do Alasca por causa de candidatos com o mesmo nome
pt.body: O Departamento de Justiça tentou isolar alguns votos do Alasca como parte de uma investigação sobre se a presença de dois candidatos com o mesmo nome poderia confundir os eleitores, segundo The Hill. Al Jazeera informou que o problema de candidatos com o mesmo nome na urna do Alasca desencadeou uma investigação do Departamento de Justiça.

zh.headline: 司法部推动隔离阿拉斯加选票，因同名候选人问题
zh.body: 根据《The Hill》报道，司法部推动隔离部分阿拉斯加选票，以调查两位同名候选人是否会让选民产生混淆。半岛电视台报道，阿拉斯加选票上的同名问题引发了司法部的调查。

de.headline: DOJ fordert Isolierung von Alaska-Stimmzetteln wegen Kandidaten mit gleichem Namen
de.body: Das US-Justizministerium forderte die Isolierung einiger Alaska-Stimmzettel als Teil einer Untersuchung, ob die Anwesenheit von zwei Kandidaten mit demselben Namen die Wähler verwirren könnte, so die Meldung von The Hill. Al Jazeera berichtete, dass das Problem mit gleichnamigen Kandidaten auf dem Alaska-Stimmzettel eine Untersuchung des Justizministeriums ausgelöst habe.

ja.headline: 司法省、同名候補者問題を受けてアラスカ州の投票用紙を分離する方針を推進
ja.body: 司法省は、同名の候補者が2名存在することで有権者が混乱する可能性を調査する一環として、アラスカ州の一部投票用紙を分離する方針を推進したと、The Hill は報じた。アルジャジーラは、アラスカ州の投票用紙における同名問題が司法省の調査を引き起こしたと報じた。

ko.body: 법무부는 같은 이름을 가진 두 후보가 유권자를 혼란시킬 수 있는지 여부를 조사하기 위해 일부 알래스카 투표용지를 분리하려고 추진했다고 The Hill이 보도했다. 알자지라가 알래스카 투표용지의 같은 이름 문제로 법무부 조사가 촉발됐다고 보도했다.

ja.body: サウス・チュナイ・モーニング・ポストによれば、マラッカ州選挙は土曜日に79名の候補者が登録完了した状態で始まった。CNAによると、アンワール氏のPHとムヒディン氏のベルサトゥの間で対立のない4つの議席が確定した。今回の選挙は首相アンワール・イブラヒム氏の連立政権を試すものとなっている。
ja.headline: マラッカ州選挙、79名の候補者が登録完了し開幕

ko.body: 남중국중앙일보에 따르면 말라카 주선거는 토요일에 79명의 후보가 확정돼 시작됐다. CNA에 따르면 안와르의 PH와 무히딘의 베르사투 사이에 충돌 없이 4개의 좌석이 확정됐다. 이번 선거는 아나워 이브라힘 총리의 연합을 시험한다.
ko.headline: 말라카 주선거가 79명의 후보가 확정돼 시작

pt.body: De acordo com o South China Morning Post, a eleição do estado de Melaka começou no sábado com 79 candidatos aprovados. De acordo com a CNA, quatro assentos foram confirmados sem confrontos entre o PH de Anwar e o Bersatu de Muhyiddin. A eleição testa a coalizão do Primeiro‑Ministro Anwar Ibrahim.
pt.headline: Eleição do estado de Melaka começa com 79 candidatos aprovados

zh.body: 据《南华早报》报道，马六甲州选举于周六开始，79名候选人已获准参选。根据CNA报道，四个席位在安瓦尔的PH与穆希丁的Bersatu之间未出现冲突。此次选举考验了总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣的联盟。
zh.headline: 马六甲州选举开始，79名候选人已获准参选

sources.title: Malaysia’s Melaka poll begins as 79 cleared in test for Anwar’s coalition
Melaka state election: Anwar's PH, Muhyiddin's Bersatu avoid clashes in 4 seats as candidates confirmed

de.body: Ein Bundesrichter verhinderte, dass die Trump-Administration Wahlhelfer mit Strafverfolgung bedroht, die sich auf Stimmzettel beziehen, die angeblich von Nichtbürgern stammen, so Fox News. The Hill berichtete, dass der Richter die Administration angewiesen hat, die Bedrohungen einzustellen.
de.headline: Bundesrichter blockiert DOJ-Bedrohungen gegen Wahlhelfer

en.body: A federal judge blocked the Trump administration from threatening election workers with prosecution over ballots tied to suspected noncitizens, according to Fox News. The Hill reported the judge ordered the administration to stop the threats.
en.headline: Federal judge blocks DOJ threats against election workers

es.body: Un juez federal impidió que la administración Trump amenazara a los trabajadores electorales con procesos judiciales por papeletas vinculadas a sospechosos de no ciudadanos, según Fox News. The Hill informó que el juez ordenó a la administración cesar las amenazas.
es.headline: Juez federal bloquea amenazas del DOJ a trabajadores electorales

fr.body: Un juge fédéral a empêché l'administration Trump de menacer les travailleurs électoraux d'une poursuite concernant des bulletins liés à des non-citoyens suspects, selon Fox News. The Hill a rapporté que le juge a ordonné à l'administration d'arrêter ces menaces.
fr.headline: Un juge fédéral bloque les menaces du ministère de la Justice contre les travailleurs électoraux

it.body: Un giudice federale ha impedito all'amministrazione Trump di minacciare i lavoratori elettorali con procedimenti penali per schede elettorali legate a sospetti non cittadini, secondo Fox News. The Hill ha riferito che il giudice ha ordinato all'amministrazione di cessare le minacce.
it.headline: Giudice federale blocca minacce del DOJ contro i lavoratori elettorali

ja.body: 連邦裁判官が、トランプ政権が非市民疑惑に関連する投票に関して選挙作業員を訴追で脅迫することを阻止したとFox Newsは報じた。The Hillは、裁判官が政権に脅迫を停止するよう命じたと報じた。
ja.headline: 連邦裁判官、選挙作業員への司法省脅迫を阻止

ko.body: 연방 판사는 트럼프 행정부가 의심되는 비시민과 관련된 투표용지에 대해 선거 근로자를 기소 위협하는 것을 차단했다고 Fox News가 보도했다. The Hill은 판사가 행정부에게 위협을 중단하라고 명령했다고 보도했다.
ko.headline: 연방 판사, 선거 근로자에 대한 DOJ의 위협 차단

pt.body: Um juiz federal impediu a administração de Trump de ameaçar trabalhadores eleitorais com processos por votos ligados a suspeitos de não-cidadãos, segundo a Fox News. O The Hill relatou que o juiz ordenou à administração que cessasse as ameaças.
pt.headline: Juiz federal impede ameaças do DOJ a trabalhadores eleitorais

zh.body: 据 Fox News 报道，一名联邦法官阻止特朗普政府对与疑似非公民相关的选票的选举工作人员进行起诉威胁。The Hill 报道，法官命令政府停止此类威胁。
zh.headline: 联邦法官阻止司法部对选举工作人员的威胁

sources.title: Federal judge blocks Trump DOJ threats against election workers ahead of 2026 midterms
Judge blocks DOJ from threatening election officials over noncitizen voting claims

de.body: Die Trump-Administration genehmigte einen möglichen Verkauf von Patriot-Raketen an die Ukraine, so Dawn. ABC Australia berichtete, dass der Verkauf 3 Milliarden US-Dollar wert war.
de.headline: USA genehmigt Verkauf von 3 Milliarden US-Dollar an Patriot-Raketen an die Ukraine

en.body: The Trump administration approved a potential sale of Patriot missiles to Ukraine, according to Dawn. ABC Australia reported the sale was valued at $3 billion.
en.headline: US approves $3 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine

es.body: La administración Trump aprobó una posible venta de misiles Patriot a Ucrania, según Dawn. ABC Australia informó que la venta se valoró en 3 miles de millones de dólares.
es.headline: EE. UU. aprueba la venta de 3 miles de millones de dólares de misiles Patriot a Ucrania

fr.body: L'administration Trump a approuvé une vente potentielle de missiles Patriot à l'Ukraine, selon Dawn. ABC Australia a rapporté que la vente valait 3 milliards de dollars.
fr.headline: Les États-Unis approuvent la vente de missiles Patriot d'une valeur de 3 milliards de dollars à l'Ukraine

it.body: L'amministrazione Trump ha approvato una potenziale vendita di missili Patriot all'Ucraina, secondo Dawn. ABC Australia ha riportato che la vendita è stata valutata a 3 miliardi di dollari.
it.headline: USA approva vendita di missili Patriot da 3 miliardi di dollari all'Ucraina

ja.body: トランプ政権は、Dawnによれば、ウクライナへのパトリオットミサイルの潜在的販売を承認した。ABCオーストラリアは、販売額を30億ドルと報じた。
ja.headline: 米国、ウクライナへのパトリオットミサイル販売を30億ドルで承認

ko.body: 트럼프 행정부가 Dawn에 따르면 우크라이나에 파트리어트 미사일을 판매할 가능성을 승인했다고 보도했다. ABC Australia는 이 판매가 30억 달러 가치라고 보도했다.
ko.headline: 미국, 우크라이나에 30억 달러 규모의 파트리어트 미사일 판매 승인

pt.body: A administração de Trump aprovou uma potencial venda de mísseis Patriot à Ucrânia, segundo a Dawn. A ABC Australia informou que a venda foi avaliada em 3 bilhões de dólares.
pt.headline: Estados Unidos aprovam venda de mísseis Patriot de 3 bilhões de dólares à Ucrânia

zh.body: 据 Dawn 报道，特朗普政府批准向乌克兰出售爱国者导弹，ABC Australia 报道该交易价值30亿美元。
zh.headline: 美国批准向乌克兰出售30亿美元的爱国者导弹

sources.title: Trump admin approves potential Patriot missiles sale to Ukraine
US approves $3 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine
